primaryGoal: Track week-over-week performance for all 6 KPIs (M1 ACV, M1 Count, S0 ACV, S0 Count, S1 ACV, S1 Count) by calculating this week's value, last week's value, absolute change, percentage change, and percentage of target achieved—both overall and segmented by Creation Target Region Segment.
assumptions: The [Creation Month] field accurately captures the week in which opportunities were created and is suitable for week-over-week comparison.
'This week' and 'last week' refer to complete calendar weeks that can be identified via the [Creation Month] field.

Target values ([Creation ACV Target] and [Creation Target]) are cumulative or appropriately set for the period being analyzed.
Each KPI (M1, S0, S1) is uniquely identified by the [Creation Target Creation Metric] attribute.
Regional segments in [Creation Target Region Segment] are complete and mutually exclusive for breakdown analysis.
